prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 重点城市季度GDP增速对比表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "城市" spans 1 col × 2 row; "季度增速（%）" spans 4 col × 1 row; "说明" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "城市" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 35px
  col 2: header "季度增速（%） › 一季度" · longest unbreakable word 25px · one-line width 53px
  col 3: header "季度增速（%） › 二季度" · longest unbreakable word 25px · one-line width 53px
  col 4: header "季度增速（%） › 三季度" · longest unbreakable word 25px · one-line width 53px
  col 5: header "季度增速（%） › 四季度" · longest unbreakable word 25px · one-line width 53px
  col 6: header "说明" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 867px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 480px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 479px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"对比六个重点城市四个季度的GDP增速，并结合说明理解各城市的经济表现。","reading":"读者主要横向比较同一城市的季度变化，也会纵向比较不同城市在同一季度的增速；说明提供背景，通常在发现差异后阅读。说明文字较长，会主导各数据行的高度，因此城市名和增速可以利用同一行已有的高度保持清晰。","groups":["第2至第5列都是季度增速，作用相同，应保持相同宽度，便于横向和纵向比较。","第1列城市名标识整行；第6列说明为该城市的增速提供背景。"],"keep_intact":["城市名称","各季度的增速数值","百分比符号"],"may_wrap":["说明中的中文叙述可自然换行。","空间紧张时，季度子表头可换行；四列应采用一致的宽度和换行节奏。","跨四列的总表头可在必要时换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [56, 57, 57, 57, 57, 195] · table 480×922px · row heights [39, 66, 145, 145, 118, 118, 145, 145] · column headers wrapped 4/7 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [56, 74, 74, 74, 74, 127] · table 480×1343px · row heights [39, 39, 250, 224, 197, 197, 197, 197] · column headers wrapped 0/7 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [56, 55, 55, 55, 55, 203] · table 480×948px · row heights [39, 92, 145, 145, 118, 118, 145, 145] · column headers wrapped 4/7 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"四个季度等宽，增速数值和城市名完整，便于横向比较；说明列有足够空间形成较自然的文字块，各行仍能清楚对应城市。","problems":"季度子表头都将“度”单独留在第二行，表头显得零碎；说明中部分行末也出现孤立的字或标点。","cause":"每个季度列宽57px，扣除内边距和边框后只有36px，容不下完整的三字子表头；说明列195px仍需频繁换行。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"季度子表头和数值均完整显示，四列等宽，表头层级清楚。","problems":"说明被挤成很窄的文字条，换行频繁，数据行过高；城市与增速区域随之出现大块空白，跨城市比较也需要更长的视线移动。","cause":"四个季度列各占74px，虽然恰好容纳单行子表头，却使说明列只剩127px。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"季度列等宽，城市名与增速数值完整；说明列比r1A稍宽，正文仍可读。","problems":"季度子表头逐字竖排，识别和横向比较都较费力；正文行高与r1A相同，额外的说明宽度没有带来明显改善，表头反而更高。","cause":"季度列缩至55px后，可用文字宽度不足以并排放下两个汉字；说明列增至203px，但不足以改变这些正文的行数。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"compact-balanced","widths":[56,58,58,58,58,191],"change":"以r1A为基础，将四个季度列各加宽1px，检查子表头能否保持一致的两行节奏，同时尽量保留说明列的阅读宽度。"},{"name":"narrative-room","widths":[56,56,56,56,56,199],"change":"将季度列设在r1A与r1C之间，测试能否保留两行子表头，同时为说明争取更多宽度。"},{"name":"full-headers","widths":[56,74,74,74,74,127],"change":"保留完整单行季度表头作为对照；与紧凑方案比较时，重点衡量表头清晰度是否足以抵消说明列过窄和行距过高的问题。"}]}
